name: Arugula Salad with Pan-Fried Chicken, Butternut Squash, Apple & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small butternut squash
3 Granny Smith apples
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden brown and fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the chicken is cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
When the butternut squash is done, remove from the oven and let cool, about 5 minutes.
Add cooled squash, arugula, and feta to the bowl with the dressing and apple. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with chicken. Enjoy!
